item.title: ComfyUI-UML: diagrams as nodes, images and shareable source
item.description:
antoinebou12/ComfyUI-UML

★ 3 · 3 forks · Repository created 2026-02-23

GitHub statistics recorded 2026-10-20.

ComfyUI is useful beyond image generation when an intermediate result can become a node output. ComfyUI-UML applies that idea to diagrams: text enters a rendering node; an image, a saved file, and a shareable URL can leave it.

item.title: uml-mcp — UML diagrams from chat via MCP
item.description:
[1]

uml-mcp[1] gives an MCP client real diagram tools: an assistant supplies Mermaid, PlantUML, or another supported diagram source, and the server returns rendered output and useful links. The current repository documents five tools and a catalog of roughly 37 Kroki-backed types. Those counts describe the documented interface, not a rendering benchmark.

item.title: 25k uses for the diagram tool on the GPT Store
item.description: The diagram tool reached 25k uses on the GPT Store. At school, UML is how we share an idea, and I built the tool so I would stop dragging boxes and arrows in Lucidchart.

item.title: Diagram prompts with ChatGPT and AIPRM (PlantUML, Mermaid, and more)
item.description: I got tired of one-off ChatGPT threads that “draw a sequence diagram” and return half-random syntax. AIPRM[1] helps because the template lives in the browser; I lock four fields — diagram type, elements, purpose, tool — and the model stops guessing whether I want PlantUML, Mermaid, or notes for Draw.io. Related: the D2C OpenAI diagram plugin post.
